title: Stratified sentinel-suite and automated rollback heuristics for cost-driven batch/cache changes
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Scope: Build a production-ready evaluation and gating system that detects quality regressions tied to automated batching and KV-cache configuration recommendations. This ticket implements a stratified sentinel corpus, automated statistical acceptance windows, and deterministic rollback heuristics that are driven by observed quality regressions and customer-impact signals. The goal is to enable safe automated application of cost-saving batch/cache configs while bounding user-visible regressions and providing human-in-the-loop audit when required.

Background: We already have pilots that suggest up to 35% token-cost savings via more aggressive batching and prefix reuse, but some workloads show subtle quality drift (response truncation, increased hallucination, or changed tokenization alignment). Past incidents were hard to triage because coverage of golden prompts was sparse and thresholds were global rather than stratified by flow.

This ticket covers: (1) building a stratified sentinel suite with buckets for anchor/representative flows, adversarial edge-cases, and hallucination probes; (2) per-bucket acceptance thresholds and statistical testing (paired comparisons / non-parametric where appropriate); (3) rollout policy integration (progressive percentages + health windows); (4) automatic rollback heuristics and human audit triggers; (5) telemetry and alerting dashboards for triage.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement automatic model swaps (separate change) nor full UI surfaces in Console (we will wire basic signals into existing rollout UI).
acceptance_criteria:
1) Sentinel suite contains at least 5 buckets (anchor, high-frequency canonical, low-frequency corner-case, hallucination probes, latency-sensitive queries) with 200 exemplars each where available.
2) Automated evaluation harness computes per-bucket metrics (embedding-similarity, token-level edit distance, hallucination-score, surrogate user-satisfaction) and a composite quality delta.
3) Acceptance gates defined as: per-bucket quality delta < 1.5% or effect size (Cliff's delta) < 0.1, and no bucket shows >2% regression with p-value < 0.05 (paired test).
4) Progressive rollout policy implemented (5%, 25%, 50%, 100%) with >15m stable window at each stage; violations cause automatic rollback to previous stable config and create a ticket.
5) Human audit workflow triggered when composite quality delta exceeds thresholds OR customer-impact label marked medium/high.
6) Dashboards surface cost delta, per-bucket metrics, and rollback events.
implementation_plan:
Phase 1: Define sentinel buckets and collect exemplars from telemetry/benchmarks and customer probe sets. Phase 2: Implement evaluation harness in the CI runner that can execute new batch/cache configs against the sentinel suite and produce per-metric deltas and statistical summaries. Phase 3: Integrate gate logic into the rollout service (canary controller) with deterministic rollback heuristics and ticket creation. Phase 4: Add monitoring, alerting, and human audit playbook. Phase 5: Run internal canaries on non-critical model routes for two weeks.

Tech notes: Use paired Wilcoxon test or paired bootstrap for non-normal metrics; compute Cliff's delta for effect size; prefer embedding-similarity (cosine on instruction+response embeddings) for semantic drift and token-level normalized Levenshtein for formatting regressions. Persist results to the eval bucket index; expose via /internal-eval API.

Owner: ENG-Serve (Ravi). Collaborators: PM (Lina Chen), DX (Suresh Rao), Research (Maya Patel).
test_plan:
- Unit tests for metric calculators (embedding sim, edit distance, hallucination detector).
- Synthetic regressions injected to assert gate firing and rollback behavior.
- Canary runs with known safe and unsafe configs to validate thresholds.
- Human audit trial: 100 samples blinded across before/after for manual QA on flagged canaries.
- Load test the evaluation harness to ensure it can run against 2000 examples in parallel without affecting production runtime.

Deliverables: CI job definition, eval-result artifact format, test harness, automated rollback playbook.
rollout_plan: Start with non-critical public routes (model: open-1.5-medium) using feature-flagged rollouts: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. At each step the canary controller checks composite quality delta and per-bucket gates over a 15-minute steady window. If any gate trips or customer-impact signals appear, controller will: (a) immediately revert to last stable config, (b) create an incident ticket populated with eval artifacts and graphs, (c) notify on #runtime-rollouts and paging channel. For manual apply flows, require PM sign-off when any per-bucket metric shows regression > 1%.
monitoring: Dashboards: 'Sentinel Suite Health' (per-bucket deltas over time), 'Cost vs Quality' (cost savings curve vs composite quality delta), 'Rollback Events' stream. Alerts: severity=prod-p1 if composite delta > 3% AND cost savings > 10% (possible high-impact regression); severity=prod-p2 for single-bucket p-value < 0.01 with effect size > 0.2. Add trace links to request samples and GitHub PRs. Metrics emitted: eval.composite_delta, eval.bucket.<name>.delta, eval.p_value.<name>, eval.effect_size.<name>, rollout.rollback_count, rollout.duration.
